decision.explanation: Both answers are directly supported by the provided source segments. D1S9 explicitly states Vicente Cárcel Orti was awarded the 'National Prize of East Germany'. D2S11 and D2S13 confirm he received the title 'Dearest Son' (Hijo Predilecto) from the Autonomous Community of Valencia. The instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers requires retaining both awards found in the text.
